response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile individual-contributor engineer with deep experience in developer tooling, testing frameworks, and CI/CD infrastructure, but his 15+ year career shows no evidence of people management or formal team leadership — every role listed is an IC title (Software/Senior/Staff Developer). Since this role is fundamentally a people-management position requiring 1:1s, performance management, and team leadership, his profile is a poor fit despite his solid technical credentials.
strengths: Extensive hands-on experience building developer tools: custom test runners (Trial), assertion libraries (Fluent-Asserts), CI/CD pipelines, and GitLab/deploy infrastructure
15+ years of broad technical experience across web, mobile, embedded, and backend systems with strong TDD/craftsmanship practices
Demonstrated mentoring and knowledge-sharing via workshops, talks, and Refactoring Dojos, indicating some leadership inclination
concerns: No evidence of formal people management or direct-report responsibility anywhere in his career history
All roles are individual-contributor titles (Staff/Senior Developer), not technical lead or engineering manager positions
No stated experience with performance reviews, roadmap ownership at an organizational level, or leading organizational change

key_factors.factor: Strong developer tools / productivity engineering background
No mobile-platform depth or organizational change leadership
